hook.name: MemeowGuardHook
hook.description: A multi-feature Uniswap v4 hook for memeow launchpad pools implementing anti-snipe buy caps and temporal fee surcharges, surge fees on large buys, auto-burn of a configurable share of coin output, and volatility-adjusted LP fees (EWMA of per-swap tick moves). Also provides resting limit orders and stop-loss/trailing-stop orders, all configurable per-pool by the launchpad.
